rules.title: Limit on payments at or before start of tenancy (security deposit cap)
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a lessor or the lessor's agent may not require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than first month's rent, last month's rent at the same rate, a security deposit equal to the first month's rent, and the purchase and installation cost of a key and lock. After the tenancy starts, the lessor may not demand rent in advance beyond the current month's rent or a deposit above the allowed amount.
rules.key_value: Security deposit equal to the first month's rent; total upfront limited to first month's rent + last month's rent + security deposit + key and lock cost
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property and their agents, for tenants and prospective tenants.
rules.citation: General Laws Chapter 186, Section 15B(1)(b), as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55
rules.quoted_span: (b) At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:

rules.title: Fee in lieu of security deposit
rules.requirement: The executive office of housing and livable communities may issue regulations allowing an optional fee in lieu of a security deposit. Any such fee, alone or combined with a security deposit, may not exceed 1 month's rent in total.
rules.key_value: Total fee (and any deposit) not to exceed 1 month's rent
rules.coverage_text: Lessors and tenants or prospective tenants who agree to a fee in lieu of a security deposit under regulations of the executive office of housing and livable communities.
rules.quoted_span: (C) limit the total sum of the fee or recurring payments, regardless of the duration of the lease and any extensions thereto, to an amount not to exceed 1 month's rent;

rules.title: Security deposit receipt
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent who receives a security deposit must give a signed receipt at that time stating the amount, the recipient's name, the lessor's name if received by an agent, the date received and a description of the premises.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors and their agents who receive a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor or his agent who receives a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall give said tenant or prospective tenant at the time of receiving such security deposit a receipt indicating the amount of such security deposit, the name of the person receiving it and, in the case of an agent, the name of the lessor for whom such security deposit is received, the date on which it is received, and a description of the premises leased or rented.

rules.title: Statement of condition
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent who accepts a security deposit must give the tenant a separate written statement of the premises' present condition, listing existing damage, upon receipt of the deposit or within ten days after the tenancy begins, whichever is later.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property and their agents who accept a security deposit.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall, upon receipt of such security deposit, or within ten days after commencement of the tenancy, whichever is later, furnish to such tenant or prospective tenant a separate written statement of the present condition of the premises to be leased or rented.

rules.title: Security deposit held in separate interest-bearing account
rules.requirement: A security deposit must be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank in Massachusetts, beyond the reach of the lessor's creditors, and the tenant must get a receipt with the bank name, location, amount and account number within thirty days.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors who receive a security deposit.
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with this paragraph shall entitle the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit.
rules.quoted_span: Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.

rules.title: Interest on security deposits
rules.requirement: A lessor holding a security deposit for one year or longer must pay the tenant interest at five per cent per year, or the lesser amount the bank paid, at the end of each year of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: five per cent per year, or lesser amount received from the bank
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property who hold a security deposit for one year or longer from the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.

rules.title: Return of security deposit and permitted deductions
rules.requirement: The lessor must return the security deposit or its balance within thirty days after the tenancy ends, deducting only unpaid rent or water charges, unpaid tax escalation increases, and reasonable repair costs for tenant-caused damage (excluding reasonable wear and tear) supported by a sworn itemized list.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors holding security deposits under tenancies-at-will or written leases.
rules.penalty: The lessor forfeits the right to retain any portion of the security deposit, or to counterclaim for damage, if he fails to deposit funds as required, fails to furnish the itemized list within thirty days, uses conflicting lease provisions, fails to transfer the deposit, or fails to return the deposit within thirty days.
rules.quoted_span: The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof;
